solves.reasoning: (A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: unsatisfied - alter - similar
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: perfect - current - completely
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: miraculously - meaningfully - disenchanted
마커 원문대조: ④"maintain" ≠ 원문"alter" — 상황을 바꾸려는 노력을 안 한다는 문맥
마커 원문대조: ②"terrible" ≠ 원문"perfect" — 완벽한 직장을 꿈꾸는 문맥
마커 원문대조: ③"partially" ≠ 원문"completely" — 완전히 바꾸라는 주장
빈칸 원문대조: "alter" (ctx: do little to meaningfully ___ their current situation)
빈칸 원문대조: "approach" (ctx: completely switch up your ___)
빈칸 원문대조: "disenchanted" (ctx: quickly become just as ___ as they were before)
alter=change(바꾸다). keep은 반대, ignore/describe 무관 → ① change
disenchanted=disappointed(실망한). delighted/satisfied는 반대, surprised 감정 종류 다름 → ③ disappointed
completely=entirely(완전히). partially/slightly 반대, rarely 빈도 → ④ entirely
similar↔different. alike/identical 동의어 함정, expensive 의미축 다름 → ② different
current↔former. present/modern 동의어 함정, similar 의미축 다름 → ③ former
(A) switch up your approach=접근법(명사), (B) deadline begins to approach=다가오다(동사) → ① 접근법-다가오다
difficult to understand/explain/identify=mysterious(불가사의한). obvious는 반대 → ④ mysterious
어형변환: the ___ (believe) that → 관사 the 뒤 명사 자리 → belief
어형변환: will ___ (miracle) change → 동사 change 수식 부사 자리 → miraculously
빈칸 원문대조: "switch up" (ctx: you've got to completely ___ your approach)
빈칸 원문대조: "stumble into" (ctx: miraculously change and they'll ___ the perfect job)
